boards.hardware: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM); 1.69-inch 240x280 ST7789 touch LCD (CST816); ES8311 + ES7210 audio; 24-pin DVP camera connector (this firmware drives a GC2145); TF card slot
boards.identify: Two USB-C ports; 1.69-inch touch screen; camera on a 24-pin ribbon connector; six ADC buttons
boards.flash_port: Left USB-C (CH9102F USB-UART, automatic download). The right USB-C is the chip's own USB, not for flashing.
boards.use: Touch home screen with three apps: camera preview, voice to the agent, WAV recording to the TF card; links over BLE with the Deotaland App
boards.notes: Pin-compatible with Espressif's ESP32-S3-Korvo-2 V3, but the screen code is for this board's 240x280 ST7789. Espressif's own Korvo-2 uses a different LCD board, so the screen may not work there.

zh.hardware: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8（16 MB Flash，8 MB PSRAM）；1.69 寸 240x280 ST7789 触摸屏（CST816）；ES8311 + ES7210 音频；24P DVP 摄像头座（本固件驱动 GC2145）；TF 卡座
zh.identify: 两个 USB-C 口；1.69 寸触摸屏；摄像头接在 24P 排线座上；6 个 ADC 按键
zh.flash_port: 左边的 USB-C（CH9102F 串口芯片，带自动下载）。右边的 USB-C 是芯片自带的 USB，不用来烧录。
zh.use: 触摸主屏，三个应用：摄像头预览、语音发给智能体、录音存到 TF 卡；通过 BLE 连 Deotaland App
zh.notes: 和乐鑫官方 ESP32-S3-Korvo-2 V3 引脚兼容，但屏幕代码是按这块板的 240x280 ST7789 写的；乐鑫官方 Korvo-2 的屏幕板不同，屏幕可能不亮。
